learning_outcomes:
IFAA Outcomes 1. Major
Programme: The graduates from this programme will have effective
business communication skills. (S) effective
analytical and problem solving skills which support them to make
business decisions. (S) the
ability to integrate business knowledge in a business environment. (K/S) the
ability to propose strategies in a global environment. (S) the
ability to be aware of the ethical issues in a business context. (V) a
specific knowledge in insurance, finance and actuarial science.
(K/S) K = Knowledge outcomes S = Skills outcomes V = Values and
attitudes outcomes
